major_nations_and_cities.description: The primary political powers and urban centers of the Northern Continent.

list.name: Loen Kingdom
list.description: A constitutional monarchy and the primary setting of the first book. It is a major power known for its industrial might and significant Beyonder organizations.

list.name: Backlund
list.description: The sprawling capital of the Loen Kingdom, a Victorian-era metropolis divided into districts, from the wealthy to the impoverished. It is the center of political intrigue and Beyonder activity.

list.name: Tingen
list.description: A mid-sized city in the Loen Kingdom, known as the 'City of Universities.' It is where the protagonist's journey begins and is home to a branch of the Nighthawks.

list.name: Intis Republic
list.description: A powerful republic modeled after France, known for its culture and as the primary setting for the second book, *Circle of Inevitability*.

list.name: Trier
list.description: The capital city of the Intis Republic, modeled after Paris. It is a grand city of culture, art, and intrigue.

list.name: Feynapotter Kingdom
list.description: A kingdom neighboring Intis, associated with the Mother Pathway and the Earth Mother church. It is known for its agricultural prosperity.

list.name: Feysac Empire
list.description: A continental power known for its military strength and deep religious traditions, often at odds with the Loen Kingdom.

list.name: Rorsted Archipelago
list.description: A chain of islands in the sea between continents, a hub for pirates, trade, and colonial powers.

list.name: Bayam
list.description: A port city in the Rorsted Archipelago known for its diverse population, supernatural activity, and the influence of the Sea God.

list.name: Cordu Village
list.description: A small, isolated village in the mountains of Intis, where the protagonist of *Circle of Inevitability* grew up. It is the site of mysterious supernatural events.

list.name: City of Silver
list.description: An ancient city located in the Forsaken Land of the Gods, perpetually shrouded in darkness. Its people fight for survival against corrupted creatures and worship the Eternal Blazing Sun.
